'''Kor Vanderijar''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the ''[[Bootana Hutta/Legends|Bootana Hutta]]'' region of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. It was the [[Throneworld/Legends|throneworld]] of the [[Vanderijar]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]].

Kor Vanderijar was located in close proximity to [[Kor Jiramma]], the throneworld of the [[Jiramma]] kajidic. This proximity led the Vanderijar to often partner with the Jiramma.
